about: Pinned values for Eym's world (tools/world-checks.mjs). 'fixed' are invariants no tool changes: the owner's maps. 'managed' follow the world: a rebuild that moves one reports it, and node tools/world.mjs --accept-pins records the new value with a note.

registryCsvSha256.note: Land-growth scaling, Fix 4: the surface and tectonics tools changed (sphere grid for land too large for a flat frame; wrap-aware box in the tectonics tool), so Eym's input fingerprint in the registry changed. The plate history was fitted again and every derived file has the same content; only source stamps and fingerprints differ.
